title: The Godfather
plot: An aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty decides to hand power to his youngest and most reluctant son after an assassination attempt. Over three decades, a family built on loyalty slowly drowns in betrayal, vengeance, and violence.
clues: A dynasty passes from father to reluctant son in a world of quiet omertà.
Francis Ford Coppola, 1972 — organised-crime epic spanning three generations.
Marlon Brando plays the don; Al Pacino is the son who swore he would never enter the family business.

title: Jaws
plot: A New England coastal town is terrorised by an enormous man-eating great white shark during tourist season. A police chief with a fear of water, an eccentric marine biologist, and a grizzled hunter set sail to destroy the beast.
clues: You're going to need a bigger boat — three men, one ocean, one monster.
Steven Spielberg, 1975 — the summer blockbuster that made everyone afraid of open water.
Roy Scheider plays a landlubbing police chief who teams up with a scientist and a salty old hunter.

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
normalized_title: star wars episode iv a new hope
plot: A young farm boy from a desert planet joins a ragtag rebellion against a galaxy-spanning galactic empire and its planet-destroying superweapon, guided by the wisdom of the last knight of an ancient mystical order.
clues: The mystical force binds a galaxy at war; a desert farm boy discovers his destined lineage.
George Lucas, 1977 — the space opera that transformed modern blockbuster cinema.
Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher, and Harrison Ford battle an empire and a dark lord in black armor.

title: Jurassic Park
plot: A wealthy entrepreneur invites a team of scientists to tour an island wildlife preserve featuring genetically resurrected ancient reptiles. When sabotage disables the security grid, survivors must flee the predatory apex creatures on foot.
clues: Life finds a way — and then breaches every electric perimeter on the tropical island.
Steven Spielberg, 1993 — cloned prehistoric predators run amok on a remote Costa Rican island.
Sam Neill plays a paleontologist protecting children alongside a chaos theorist played by Jeff Goldblum.

title: The Lion King
plot: A royal lion cub flees into exile after his treacherous uncle murders the king and seizes the throne. Reared by carefree companions, the adult heir must confront his past and reclaim his rightful place in the great circle of life.
clues: Betrayal in the savanna leaves a young royal in guilt-ridden exile until ancestral duty calls him back.
Disney animation, 1994 — a Shakespearean drama transposed to an African animal kingdom.
Features the voices of Matthew Broderick as the exiled prince and Jeremy Irons as his murderous uncle Scar.

title: Forrest Gump
plot: A kind-hearted Alabama man with a low IQ witnesses and unintentionally influences historical milestones of the twentieth century, all while longing to reunite with his troubled childhood companion.
clues: Life is like a box of chocolates; he ran across the continent and kept his simple promise.
Robert Zemeckis, 1994 — an accidental journey through the Vietnam War, ping pong diplomacy, and Watergate.
Tom Hanks won Best Actor for playing a pure-hearted runner who achieves unexpected American greatness.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: The lives of two philosophizing mob hitmen, a prizefighter on the run, a gangster's alluring wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four non-linear tales of underworld crime, redemption, and violence in Los Angeles.
clues: Non-linear vignettes in Southern California; a glowing briefcase and a customized wallet.
Quentin Tarantino, 1994 — Palme d'Or-winning neo-noir with snappy dialogue and surf rock soundtracks.
John Travolta and Samuel L. Jackson star as sharply suited enforcers discussing royal burgers between jobs.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: A quiet banker falsely convicted of double homicide endures decades of brutal treatment in a corrupt state penitentiary, maintaining dignity and nurturing a secret escape strategy through patience and a small rock hammer.
clues: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies behind prison stone.
Frank Darabont, 1994 — celebrated prison drama adapted from a Stephen King novella.
Tim Robbins plays the framed banker while Morgan Freeman narrates as his contraband-smuggling confidant.

title: Toy Story
plot: A vintage pull-string cowboy doll finds his status as a child's favorite bedroom plaything threatened by an arrogant new laser-equipped astronaut action figure, sparking a rivalry that becomes an alliance when they are lost outdoors.
clues: To infinity and beyond, seen from the perspective of an insecure vintage cowboy doll.
Pixar, 1995 — the historic first feature-length entirely computer-animated movie.
Tom Hanks voices the loyal sheriff toy while Tim Allen voices the delusional spaceman who thinks he is real.

title: Clueless
plot: A superficial but genuinely well-meaning Beverly Hills high schooler attempts to improve the lives of teachers and classmates through matchmaking and fashion makeovers, only to realize how oblivious she is to her own feelings.
clues: As if! A Beverly Hills socialite redesigns everyone else's romances while misreading her own heart.
Amy Heckerling, 1995 — high school comedy modernizing Jane Austen's Emma in 1990s Southern California.
Alicia Silverstone plays Cher Horowitz alongside Paul Rudd as her college ex-stepbrother.

title: Titanic
plot: A penniless young artist and an unhappy aristocratic woman fall in love aboard a luxurious passenger liner on its doomed maiden voyage across the North Atlantic in April 1912.
clues: An ill-fated luxury ocean liner, a blue diamond pendant, and a forbidden transatlantic romance.
James Cameron, 1997 — historic epic that won 11 Academy Awards and shattered box-office records.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet play Jack and Rose as the world's grandest ship strikes an iceberg.

title: The Matrix
plot: A disillusioned software engineer and cyber hacker is awoken by shadowy freedom fighters to the shocking revelation that perceived reality is a neural simulation created by artificial intelligence machines harvesting humanity.
clues: Choose between the red pill or the blue pill to see how deep the rabbit hole goes.
The Wachowskis, 1999 — cyberpunk action masterpiece that pioneered bullet-time cinematography.
Keanu Reeves plays Neo, Carrie-Anne Moss is Trinity, and Laurence Fishburne is the insurgent captain Morpheus.

title: Gladiator
plot: A betrayed Roman general whose family is executed by a corrupt usurping emperor is sold into arena slavery, rising through combat tournaments to seek vengeance in the Colosseum before the public eye.
clues: Are you not entertained? A fallen general fights his way through the blood-stained sands of Rome.
Ridley Scott, 2000 — sword-and-sandal historical revenge epic that captured the Best Picture Oscar.
Russell Crowe plays Maximus Decimus Meridius opposing Joaquin Phoenix as the treacherous emperor Commodus.

title: Spirited Away
plot: A stubborn young girl wanders into an abandoned amusement park that is an opulent supernatural bathhouse for spirits. After her parents are cursed into swine, she must work for a ruthless sorceress to secure their release.
clues: A young girl signs away her name to work in a grand mystical bathhouse for kami and spirits.
Hayao Miyazaki / Studio Ghibli, 2001 — Japan's record-setting animated fantasy and Oscar winner.
Follows ten-year-old Chihiro as she navigates a magical realm to free her transformed parents.

title: Inception
plot: A skilled corporate spy who infiltrates targets' subconscious minds during dream states is offered the redemption of his criminal status if he can accomplish the inverse task: planting an unshakeable idea deep inside a CEO's mind.
clues: Dreams within dreams; an architect designs gravity-defying mazes to implant an authentic thought.
Christopher Nolan, 2010 — mind-bending heist thriller featuring a spinning metal totem.
Leonardo DiCaprio leads a team of specialists descending through nested levels of shared dreaming.

title: Adavi Ramudu
plot: A forest officer in an undercover operation, raises all the tribal people and the villagers against the smugglers to teach them a lesson and gets them arrested.

title: Adavi Ramudu
plot: A poor man from a small village attends an urban college and wins the heart of a woman from a wealthy and powerful family. Her relatives disapprove. Eventually, the pair flee into the forest and are pursued by her angry family.

title: Amélie
plot: At a tiny Parisian café, the adorable yet painfully shy Amélie (Audrey Tautou) accidentally discovers a gift for helping others. Soon Amelie is spending her days as a matchmaker, guardian angel, and all-around do-gooder. But when she bumps into a handsome stranger, will she find the courage to become the star of her very own love story?

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
plot: When Shiva, the son of Bahubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
plot: The young Shivudu is left as a foundling in a small village by his mother. By the time he’s grown up, it has become apparent that he possesses exceptional gifts. He meets the beautiful warrior/princess Avanthika and learns that her queen has been held captive for the last 25 years. Shividu sets off to rescue her, discovering his own origins in the process.

title: Batman
plot: The Dynamic Duo faces four super-villains who plan to hold the world for ransom with the help of a secret invention that instantly dehydrates people.

title: Batman
plot: The Dark Knight of Gotham City begins his war on crime with his first major enemy being the clownishly homicidal Joker, who has seized control of Gotham's underworld.

title: Eega
plot: A murdered man is reincarnated as a housefly and seeks to avenge his death.

title: Fight Club
plot: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.

title: Interstellar
plot: Interstellar chronicles the adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

title: Magadheera
plot: A bike stuntman recalls his previous life as a warrior, and pursues his love's reincarnation. A sinister figure from their shared past threatens to separate them forever.

title: The Dark Knight
plot: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: The Godfather: Part II
plot: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.

title: The Godfather: Part III
plot: In the midst of trying to legitimize his business dealings in 1979 New York and Italy, aging mafia don, Michael Corleone seeks forgiveness for his sins while taking a young protege under his wing.

title: RRR
plot: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force develop a profound friendship without knowing each other's secret identities and allegiances in pre-independence India.
clues: Two legendary Indian revolutionaries forge an epic brotherhood against the British Raj.
S. S. Rajamouli, 2022 — global blockbuster featuring the electrifying Naatu Naatu dance.
N. T. Rama Rao Jr. plays Komaram Bheem; Ram Charan plays Alluri Sitarama Raju.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
plot: A coolie rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate, defying law enforcement and rival underworld lords.
clues: A fearless laborer rises through the red sandalwood syndicate of Seshachalam hills.
Sukumar, 2021 — rustic action thriller known for the iconic line Thaggedhe Le.
Allu Arjun plays Pushpa Raj; Rashmika Mandanna plays Srivalli; Fahadh Faasil is the ruthless SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
plot: In a dystopian world in the post-apocalyptic year 2898 AD, a legendary warrior awakens to protect the unborn child destined to bring balance to humanity.
clues: Ancient mythology collides with a dystopian cyberpunk future in the year 2898 AD.
Nag Ashwin, 2024 — monumental sci-fi spectacle spanning Kasi, Complex, and Shambhala.
Prabhas plays the bounty hunter Bhairava; Amitabh Bachchan is the immortal warrior Ashwatthama.

title: Rangasthalam
plot: A hearing-impaired villager and his educated brother take on an oppressive village president who has exploited their people for three decades.
clues: A deaf villager with a pure heart confronts a tyrannical president in a 1980s rural drama.
Sukumar, 2018 — period village revenge saga set along the Godavari river.
Ram Charan delivers an award-winning performance as Chitti Babu; Samantha Ruth Prabhu plays Rama Lakshmi.

title: Jersey
plot: A talented but failed cricketer decides to return to cricket in his late thirties, driven by the desire to fulfill his son's wish for an Indian team jersey.
clues: An emotionally resonant tale of a father who revives his cricket career in his late 30s for his young son.
Gowtam Tinnanuri, 2019 — poignant sports drama celebrated for its heartbreaking climax.
Nani stars as Arjun, a former Ranji cricketer fighting for dignity and love.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
plot: A young man neglected by his bitter father discovers he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son, leading him to enter his true family's home.
clues: A baby-swap comedy-drama where a witty son discovers his true aristocratic family.
Trivikram Srinivas, 2020 — celebrated for chartbusting music including Butta Bomma.
Allu Arjun plays Bantu; Pooja Hegde plays Amulya; Tabu plays the biological mother.

title: Mahanati
plot: The life story of South Indian actress Savitri, chronicling her dramatic rise to superstardom and subsequent tragic downfall.
clues: A poignant biopic chronicling the magnificent rise and tragic fall of South India's greatest screen queen.
Nag Ashwin, 2018 — National Award-winning tribute to cinema legend Savitri.
Keerthy Suresh delivers a career-defining performance as Savitri alongside Dulquer Salmaan as Gemini Ganesan.

title: Sita Ramam
plot: An orphaned army officer receives letters from a mysterious woman named Sita, sparking an epic romance across borders and decades.
clues: Letters delivered across a war-torn frontier reveal a timeless love story between a soldier and a princess.
Hanu Raghavapudi, 2022 — classical romantic mystery set against 1960s Kashmir.
Dulquer Salmaan plays Lieutenant Ram; Mrunal Thakur makes her Telugu debut as Sita Mahalakshmi.

title: Arjun Reddy
plot: A volatile, brilliant young medical surgeon succumbs to anger and substance abuse when his beloved is pressured into marrying someone else.
clues: A brilliant surgeon spiraling into self-destructive fury after losing the love of his life.
Sandeep Reddy Vanga, 2017 — pathbreaking, intense romantic drama.
Vijay Deverakonda achieved breakout superstardom as the rebellious Arjun Reddy.

title: Pokiri
plot: A fearless hitman who will do anything for money gets embroiled in a deadly gang war between two underworld kingpins while concealing a shock identity.
clues: A ruthless underworld killer operates between rival gangs with a legendary twist identity.
Puri Jagannadh, 2006 — industry-redefining action blockbuster in Hyderabad.
Mahesh Babu plays Pandu; Ileana D'Cruz plays Shruthi; Prakash Raj is the menacing Ali Bhai.

title: Athadu
plot: A professional hitman framed for a politician's murder takes refuge in a rural household under the identity of their long-lost grandson.
clues: A framed sharpshooter hides inside an affectionate joint family pretending to be their grandson.
Trivikram Srinivas, 2005 — stylish action-drama revered for sharp dialogue and family sentiment.
Mahesh Babu plays Nandu/Pardhu alongside Trisha Krishnan, Sonu Sood, and Prakash Raj.

title: Mayabazar
plot: Lord Krishna and Ghatotkacha use cunning illusions and magic tricks to foil the Kauravas and unite Abhimanyu with his love Sasirekha.
clues: Ghatotkacha uses magical illusion and grand feast trickery to unite two star-crossed mythological lovers.
K. V. Reddy, 1957 — timeless golden-era classic often ranked as one of the greatest Indian films of all time.
S. V. Ranga Rao gives an immortal performance as Ghatotkacha with N. T. Rama Rao as Lord Krishna.

title: Shiva
plot: A new college student is pushed to retaliate against campus extortion and gang violence orchestrated by a vicious local politician.
clues: A quiet college newcomer grabs a bicycle chain to fight mafia corruption on campus.
Ram Gopal Varma, 1989 — game-changing directorial debut that transformed Indian action cinema.
Akkineni Nagarjuna stars as Shiva alongside Raghuvaran as the dreaded Bhavani.

title: The Prestige
plot: Two stage magicians engage in a competitive and obsessive rivalry to create the ultimate illusion, with devastating sacrifices.
clues: Two rival magicians in Victorian London sacrifice everything to execute the ultimate teleportation illusion.
Christopher Nolan, 2006 — intricate psychological puzzle featuring Nikola Tesla.
Christian Bale and Hugh Jackman play the obsessed magicians Borden and Angier.

title: Parasite
plot: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.
clues: A destitute family systematically infiltrates the household of a wealthy clan.
Bong Joon-ho, 2019 — historic Oscar Best Picture winner about modern social disparity.
Song Kang-ho plays the patriarch Kim Ki-taek in this dark, razor-sharp thriller.

title: Memento
plot: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer using Polaroid photos and tattoos on his body.
clues: A man with anterograde amnesia uses tattoos and Polaroid notes to hunt his wife's killer backwards in time.
Christopher Nolan, 2000 — iconic non-linear narrative masterpiece.
Guy Pearce stars as Leonard Shelby alongside Carrie-Anne Moss.

title: Seven
plot: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.
clues: A veteran detective and his brash new partner investigate gruesome murders staged around seven deadly sins.
David Fincher, 1995 — bleak, rain-soaked neo-noir famous for its shocking desert climax.
Morgan Freeman and Brad Pitt star as detectives Somerset and Mills.

title: Whiplash
plot: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.
clues: An ambitious jazz drummer is pushed to psychological extremes by a sadistic conservatory conductor.
Damien Chazelle, 2014 — electrifying study of perfectionism and abuse in music.
Miles Teller plays Andrew Neiman; J.K. Simmons won an Academy Award as Terence Fletcher.

title: Blade Runner 2049
plot: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.
clues: A synth detective uncovers a buried secret that could plunge what is left of society into chaos.
Denis Villeneuve, 2017 — visually stunning cyberpunk sequel to Ridley Scott's sci-fi landmark.
Ryan Gosling stars as Officer K alongside Harrison Ford returning as Rick Deckard.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
plot: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer who skins his victims.
clues: An FBI trainee seeks psychological guidance from an imprisoned cannibalistic psychiatrist to catch Buffalo Bill.
Jonathan Demme, 1991 — psychological thriller that swept all Big Five Academy Awards.
Jodie Foster plays Clarice Starling; Anthony Hopkins delivers an indelible performance as Dr. Hannibal Lecter.

title: Back to the Future
plot: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the eccentric scientist Doc Brown.
clues: A teenager accidentally travels back to 1955 in a plutonium-powered DeLorean and must get his teenage parents to fall in love.
Robert Zemeckis, 1985 — quintessential time-travel adventure filled with 1.21 gigawatts of charm.
Michael J. Fox stars as Marty McFly; Christopher Lloyd is the unforgettable Doc Brown.

title: The Departed
plot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.
clues: An undercover state trooper and a mob mole inside the police department play a lethal cat-and-mouse game in South Boston.
Martin Scorsese, 2006 — Oscar-winning adaptation of Infernal Affairs set against the Irish mob.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Matt Damon star alongside Jack Nicholson as mob boss Frank Costello.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform after investigating an unknown transmission on an isolated moon.
clues: In space, no one can hear you scream as the crew of the Nostromo confronts a lethal extraterrestrial organism.
Ridley Scott, 1979 — masterclass in sci-fi tension and claustrophobic dread with designs by H.R. Giger.
Sigourney Weaver stars as the iconic survivor Ellen Ripley.
